incident_bot: INCIDENT 3798765432 — elevated request rate observed against /v1/embeddings (ingress edge). Paging SRE oncall @alice_chen :rotating_light:

alice_chen: Oncall Alice here, looking now. Which regions and any error classes?

bob_khan: Spike concentrated EU-W and US-E, lots of short lived connections from many /24s. 5xxs low, 429s up and token usage spike.

maya_rodriguez: Early CS signal — two customers reported latency > 5s on embeddings calls, one timed out. No billing anomalies yet.

alice_chen: Ok. Initial plan: enable tarpit on suspicious IP ranges, increase per-key rate-slice for embeddings to reduce 429 cascade, and temporarily disable async-batching for embeddings to stop fanout.

alice_chen: Applying quick WAF rule to block fingerprinted bot headers and apply tarpit for offending CIDRs.

alice_chen: Command (edge control plane):
```
POST /waf/rules
{
  "action":"tarpit",
  "match": {"header":"x-client-hash", "pattern":"^bot-.*"},
  "cidr":"198.51.100.0/24,203.0.113.0/24"
}
```

deploy-bot: WAF rule created id=wr-5534, state=enabled, applied=3798765433

bob_khan: Also deploying a rate-slice change on embeddings route: reduce burst window and add strict per-key quanta. Pushing config now.

alice_chen: Config pushed. Quick curl we used to change quota slice: 
```
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood/internal/routing
 -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","quota_slice":"strict-embed-1"}'
```

deploy-bot: Routing config accepted, change-id=cfg-8802, active=3798765434

charlie_lee: CX update: letting affected customers (IDs: cust-42, cust-117, cust-204) know we are mitigating. Drafted note for Maya to approve.

maya_rodriguez: Approving. Message: "We're throttling anomalous traffic and restoring service; you may see transient rate limits for 10-30m."

alice_chen: Metrics check: RPS for embeddings from those CIDRs dropped ~92% within 90s of tarpit. Overall 429s down 70% vs peak. Latency trending down.

bob_khan: We're seeing some legitimate client keys also hit the stricter slice — adding fallback rule to route trusted keys to dedicated slice. Patch in flight.

alice_chen: Handing off to @bob_khan for follow-up investigations (IP attribution, update fingerprint rules, blocklist tuning). I'll stay on monitoring for 1 hour then unassign. :thumbsup:

bob_khan: Acknowledged. I'll run a short aggregation job to map fingerprint -> ASN and check for proxy farms.

charlie_lee: CX will do post-mortem note if customer impact > 20 min. Current ETA to steady state: 15m.

alice_chen: Closing immediate mitigation steps. Leaving tarpit and quota-slice in place until COB unless Bob requests change. If any regression, page SRE again.

incident_bot: INCIDENT 3798765432 status=mitigated (controls active).

alice_chen: Thanks team — good job moving fast.
